intro: Backstage Pass Institute and St Joseph's PG College both sit in Hyderabad, and this page compares their recorded BSc fees, placements, admission routes and campus setting, using our database and official pages we opened in 2026.

Backstage Pass Institute vs St Joseph's PG College is not a single winner. Both are recorded as private institutes. Pick the campus that matches the programme you want, the fee you can pay, and the admission test you will take.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what the official pages say
paragraphs: On this page we quote a programme total when we hold a Total Fees record, and we skip application, hostel-only or short-course rows so a registration fee is not treated as tuition.

Our records list ₹1.5 lakh a year as tuition fees for Backstage Pass Institute's BSc (Hons) in Computer Science and Game Development. Treat that as a year figure, not a confirmed full-programme total, until you check the official notice.

Our records list ₹22,600 a year as tuition fees for St Joseph's PG College's Bachelor of Science (B.Sc) Maths, Electronics and Computer Science. Treat that as a year figure, not a confirmed full-programme total, until you check the official notice.
If fees are your only filter, confirm the current official circular for the exact programme and batch you will join, because year figures and older rows can understate the real cost.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: In our records, Backstage Pass Institute's 2020 figures are an average of ₹3 lakh and a highest of ₹9 lakh for BSc (Hons) in Computer Science and Game Development. These are historical batch outcomes, not a salary promise.

In our records, St Joseph's PG College's 2023 figures are an average of ₹4 lakh and a highest of ₹9 lakh for Bachelor of Science (B.Sc) Maths, Electronics and Computer Science. These are historical batch outcomes, not a salary promise.
The recorded years are 2020 and 2023, so the two packages should not be read as a head-to-head for the same graduating class.
